universal_catalogue.bound_scope: Overridden table; all64 input bins and all reachable feedback states, independent of sources. Resident estimate requires builder/native confirmation.

compact_layout_proof_scope: Previous startup relocation proof; current centered duration_zero image requires its own execution phase.
centered_mapping: min(63,(signedPCM+32768+512)//1024);bin32 covers[-512,511];table pcm_origin0 maps bin32 to duty32/64
scope: One analytically selected literal neutral packet and unchanged search configuration across all complete sources. Host predictions and artifact diagnostics, not a new audio release or actual emulator proof.
timing_scope: Per-source times include preparation, workset serialization, C execution, full rendering and artifact diagnostics. A resumed attempt is not a fresh full conversion benchmark; its wall time is reported separately. TRD assembly/emulator execution is separate.
decision: Reject unconditional neutral-packet replacement:6 whole-source SNR/RMS regressions occur versus matched-centered and7 versus half-joint, including substantial quiet440/quiet997/speech/entertainer losses. Lower silence RMS is insufficient; whole song also regresses versus matched and joint. All three baseline comparisons and numerical artifact increases remain explicit. No new Fuse run or release promotion is warranted for this rejected candidate.
artifact_acceptance_scope: Compare compensation and half-joint at the unchanged original source clock. Legacy fitted modulation is inapplicable when drift breaks coherence. Regression counters disclose every numeric increase with arithmetic tolerance only; no user-supplied audibility threshold exists.
metadata_finalization_scope: Root rejection decision and final diagnosis/manifest were added after the successful host run; its verification wording was corrected to warranted. The final driver has the same decision; pre-run producer archives, frozen literal, encoded data, timings, reference, gain and all diagnostics are preserved.
